claims.claim: John Wesley (1703-1791); Anglican clergyman and itinerant preacher; founder of Methodism; fellow of Lincoln College, Oxford.
Aldersgate conversion 24 May 1738: hearing Luther preface read, Wesley wrote I felt my heart strangely warmed (Journal).
Preface rule: I design plain truth for plain people; written ad populum, to the bulk of mankind.
Sermons on Several Occasions in four volumes, by John Wesley, late fellow of Lincoln-College (period imprint).
SCOPE: all 44 sermons in modern English readings with 1771/1872 check text beside the reading.
Edition: sermon 1 from the 1872 forty-four sermons; sermons 2 through 44 from the 1771 Pine printing of Wesley Works.
